name: Sense Hunger and Thirst
body:
School divination; Level alchemist/investigator 2, antipaladin 1, bard/skald 2, cleric/oracle/warpriest 2, druid 2, hunter 2, inquisitor 2, medium 1, mesmerist 2, paladin 1, psychic 2, ranger 1, shaman 2, spiritualist 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a morsel of food and a glass of water)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 minutes/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You sense the hunger and thirst of those nearby, feeling it in the air around you. You can detect creatures that are suffering from the effects of starvation and thirst within 30 feet, and you immediately know how much damage they suffered from their condition.

You determine the creatures’ approximate direction from you, though you do not sense a given creature’s identity or know which squares the creatures occupy. If you’re within 5 feet of a creature whose hunger or thirst you sense, you pinpoint that creature’s location, as if using blindsense.
